  entropy: number;
  isStable: boolean;
}

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.

  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;
  
  const sumOfWeights = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + (1 / n.frequency), 0);
  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

 * Data Handler for persisting weave state to the underlying storage layer.
 */
export class WeaveDataHandler {
  public static async persist(state: LoomState): Promise<boolean> {
    // Simulated I/O operation for production-grade persistence
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        console.log(`[Persistence] Weave ${state.weaveId} synchronized.`);
        resolve(true);
      }, 50);
    });
  }
}

 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

// --- State Mutation Algorithms ---

/**
 * Algorithms for calculating the "Combination" of threads.
 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.
 */
export const calculateEmergentProperty = (nodes: ThreadNode[]): number => {
  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;
  
  const sumOfWeights = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + (1 / n.frequency), 0);
  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

/**
 * Data Handler for persisting weave state to the underlying storage layer.
 */
export class WeaveDataHandler {
  public static async persist(state: LoomState): Promise<boolean> {
    // Simulated I/O operation for production-grade persistence
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        console.log(`[Persistence] Weave ${state.weaveId} synchronized.`);
        resolve(true);
      }, 50);
    });
  }
}

export const loomOrchestrator = new LoomService();
export const pipeline = new RealityPipeline();

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

// --- Types & Interfaces ---

export interface ThreadNode {
  id: string;
  frequency: number;
  resonance: number;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface LoomState {
  weaveId: string;
  nodes: Map<string, ThreadNode>;
  entropy: number;
  isStable: boolean;
}

// --- Core Domain Services ---

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

/**
 * Segment 3: Core Domain Services & Asynchronous Pipelines
 * Orchestrates state mutation, event-driven data handling, and domain logic.
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export interface DomainEvent<T = any> {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  payload: T;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface StateMutation<S> {
  (state: S): S;
}

/**
 * Core Domain Service: Manages the lifecycle of state transitions
 * and ensures atomic updates across the asynchronous pipeline.
 */
export class LoomDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  private state: T;
  private readonly history: DomainEvent[] = [];

  constructor(initialState: T) {
    super();
    this.state = initialState;
  }

  public getState(): T {
    return Object.freeze({ ...this.state });
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Implements a middleware-like pattern for data validation and transformation.
   */
  public async mutate(mutation: StateMutation<T>, eventType: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const previousState = this.state;
      this.state = mutation(this.state);

      const event: DomainEvent = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        type: eventType,
        payload: this.state,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };

      this.history.push(event);
      this.emit('stateChanged', { event, previousState });
      this.emit(eventType, event);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', { type: 'MUTATION_FAILURE', error });
      throw new Error(`Domain Mutation Failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown'}`);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Data Handler: Orchestrates the ingestion and normalization of 
 * disparate data streams into the domain model.
 */
export class DataIngestionHandler {
  public static normalize(raw: any): Record<string, any> {
    return {
      ...raw,
      _processedAt: Date.now(),
      _correlationId: uuidv4(),
      _integrityHash: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(raw)).toString('base64').slice(0, 16)
    };
  }

  public static async processStream(stream: AsyncIterable<any>, service: LoomDomainService<any>): Promise<void> {
    for await (const chunk of stream) {
      const normalized = this.normalize(chunk);
      await service.mutate((s) => ({ ...s, ...normalized }), 'STREAM_INGESTION');
    }
  }
}

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

// --- Types & Interfaces ---

export interface ThreadNode {
  id: string;
  frequency: number;
  resonance: number;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface LoomState {
  weaveId: string;
  nodes: Map<string, ThreadNode>;
  entropy: number;
  isStable: boolean;
}

// --- Core Domain Services ---

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

// --- Asynchronous Pipeline Handlers ---

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

// --- State Mutation Algorithms ---

/**
 * Algorithms for calculating the "Combination" of threads.
 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.
 */
export const calculateEmergentProperty = (nodes: ThreadNode[]): number => {
  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;
  
  const sumOfWeights = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + (1 / n.frequency), 0);
  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

/**
 * Data Handler for persisting weave state to the underlying storage layer.
 */
export class WeaveDataHandler {
  public static async persist(state: LoomState): Promise<boolean> {
    // Simulated I/O operation for production-grade persistence
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        console.log(`[Persistence] Weave ${state.weaveId} synchronized.`);
        resolve(true);
      }, 50);
    });
  }
}

 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.
 */
export const calculateEmergentProperty = (nodes: ThreadNode[]): number => {
  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;
  
  const sumOfWeights = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + (1 / n.frequency), 0);
  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

/**
 * Data Handler for persisting weave state to the underlying storage layer.
 */
export class WeaveDataHandler {
  public static async persist(state: LoomState): Promise<boolean> {
    // Simulated I/O operation for production-grade persistence
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        console.log(`[Persistence] Weave ${state.weaveId} synchronized.`);
        resolve(true);
      }, 50);
    });
  }
}

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export interface DomainEvent<T = any> {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  payload: T;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface StateMutation<S> {
  (state: S): S;
}

/**
 * Core Domain Service: Manages the lifecycle of state transitions
 * and ensures atomic updates across the asynchronous pipeline.
 */
export class LoomDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  private state: T;
  private readonly history: DomainEvent[] = [];

  constructor(initialState: T) {
    super();
    this.state = initialState;
  }

  public getState(): T {
    return Object.freeze({ ...this.state });
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Implements a middleware-like pattern for data validation and transformation.
   */
  public async mutate(mutation: StateMutation<T>, eventType: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const previousState = this.state;
      this.state = mutation(this.state);

      const event: DomainEvent = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        type: eventType,
        payload: this.state,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };

      this.history.push(event);
      this.emit('stateChanged', { event, previousState });
      this.emit(eventType, event);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', { type: 'MUTATION_FAILURE', error });
      throw new Error(`Domain Mutation Failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown'}`);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Data Handler: Orchestrates the ingestion and normalization of 
 * disparate data streams into the domain model.
 */
export class DataIngestionHandler {
  public static normalize(raw: any): Record<string, any> {
    return {
      ...raw,
      _processedAt: Date.now(),
      _correlationId: uuidv4(),
      _integrityHash: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(raw)).toString('base64').slice(0, 16)
    };
  }

  public static async processStream(stream: AsyncIterable<any>, service: LoomDomainService<any>): Promise<void> {
    for await (const chunk of stream) {
      const normalized = this.normalize(chunk);
      await service.mutate((s) => ({ ...s, ...normalized }), 'STREAM_INGESTION');
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Asynchronous Pipeline: Orchestrates complex business logic 
 * involving multiple domain services.
 */
export class OrchestrationPipeline {
  constructor(private readonly services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) {}

  public async executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, logic: (services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
    console.log(`[Pipeline] Initiating workflow: ${workflowId}`);
    try {

    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[Pipeline] Workflow ${workflowId} failed:`, err);
      throw err;
    }
  }
}

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

// --- Types & Interfaces ---

export interface ThreadNode {
  id: string;
  frequency: number;
  resonance: number;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface LoomState {
  weaveId: string;
  nodes: Map<string, ThreadNode>;
  entropy: number;
  isStable: boolean;
}

// --- Core Domain Services ---

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

// --- Asynchronous Pipeline Handlers ---

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

    this.state = {

      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {

      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);

      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {

      throw error;

    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;

 * and ensures atomic updates across the asynchronous pipeline.
 */
export class LoomDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  private state: T;
  private readonly history: DomainEvent[] = [];

  constructor(initialState: T) {
    super();
    this.state = initialState;
  }

  public getState(): T {
    return Object.freeze({ ...this.state });
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Implements a middleware-like pattern for data validation and transformation.
   */
  public async mutate(mutation: StateMutation<T>, eventType: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const previousState = this.state;
      this.state = mutation(this.state);

      const event: DomainEvent = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        type: eventType,
        payload: this.state,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };

      this.history.push(event);
      this.emit('stateChanged', { event, previousState });
      this.emit(eventType, event);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', { type: 'MUTATION_FAILURE', error });
      throw new Error(`Domain Mutation Failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown'}`);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Data Handler: Orchestrates the ingestion and normalization of 
 * disparate data streams into the domain model.
 */
export class DataIngestionHandler {
  public static normalize(raw: any): Record<string, any> {
    return {
      ...raw,
      _processedAt: Date.now(),
      _correlationId: uuidv4(),
      _integrityHash: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(raw)).toString('base64').slice(0, 16)
    };
  }

  public static async processStream(stream: AsyncIterable<any>, service: LoomDomainService<any>): Promise<void> {
    for await (const chunk of stream) {
      const normalized = this.normalize(chunk);
      await service.mutate((s) => ({ ...s, ...normalized }), 'STREAM_INGESTION');
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Asynchronous Pipeline: Orchestrates complex business logic 
 * involving multiple domain services.
 */
export class OrchestrationPipeline {
  constructor(private readonly services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) {}

  public async executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, logic: (services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
    console.log(`[Pipeline] Initiating workflow: ${workflowId}`);
    try {
      await logic(this.services);
      console.log(`[Pipeline] Workflow ${workflowId} completed successfully.`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[Pipeline] Workflow ${workflowId} failed:`, err);
      throw err;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * State Mutation Algorithms: Pure functions for complex domain logic.
 */
export const DomainAlgorithms = {
  mergeState: <S>(base: S, patch: Partial<S>): S => ({ ...base, ...patch }),
  
  calculateResonance: (data: number[]): number => {
    return data.reduce((acc, val) => acc + Math.sin(val), 0) / data.length;
  },

  validateIntegrity: (state: any): boolean => {
    return state !== null && typeof state === 'object' && '_correlationId' in state;
  }
};

export default {
  LoomDomainService,
  DataIngestionHandler,
  OrchestrationPipeline,
  DomainAlgorithms
};

/**/**
 * SEGMENT 2: Core Domain Services & State Mutation Logic
 * Orchestrates the "Loom" state machine, asynchronous event pipelines, 
 * and the fundamental data handlers for the reality-weave architecture.
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

// --- Types & Interfaces ---

export interface ThreadNode {
  id: string;
  frequency: number;
  resonance: number;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface LoomState {
  weaveId: string;
  nodes: Map<string, ThreadNode>;
  entropy: number;
  isStable: boolean;
}

// --- Core Domain Services ---

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

// --- Asynchronous Pipeline Handlers ---

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

// --- State Mutation Algorithms ---

/**
 * Algorithms for calculating the "Combination" of threads.
 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.
 */
export const calculateEmergentProperty = (nodes: ThreadNode[]): number => {
  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;
  
  const sumOfWeights = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + (1 / n.frequency), 0);
  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

/**
 * Data Handler for persisting weave state to the underlying storage layer.
 */
export class WeaveDataHandler {
  public static async persist(state: LoomState): Promise<boolean> {
    // Simulated I/O operation for production-grade persistence
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        console.log(`[Persistence] Weave ${state.weaveId} synchronized.`);
        resolve(true);
      }, 50);
    });
  }
}

// --- Exported Singleton for Orchestration ---

export const loomOrchestrator = new LoomService();
export const pipeline = new RealityPipeline();

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';

// --- Types & Interfaces ---

export interface ThreadNode {
  id: string;
  frequency: number;
  resonance: number;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface LoomState {
  weaveId: string;
  nodes: Map<string, ThreadNode>;
  entropy: number;
  isStable: boolean;
}

// --- Core Domain Services ---

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

// --- Asynchronous Pipeline Handlers ---

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;

  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

export class WeaveDataHandler {
  public static async persist(state: LoomState): Promise<boolean> {

}

/**
 * Segment 3: Core Domain Services & Asynchronous Pipelines
 * Orchestrates state mutation, event-driven data handling, and domain logic.
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export interface DomainEvent<T = any> {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  payload: T;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface StateMutation<S> {
  (state: S): S;
}

/**
 * Core Domain Service: Manages the lifecycle of state transitions
 * and ensures atomic updates across the asynchronous pipeline.
 */
export class LoomDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  private state: T;
  private readonly history: DomainEvent[] = [];

  constructor(initialState: T) {
    super();
    this.state = initialState;
  }

  public getState(): T {
    return Object.freeze({ ...this.state });
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Implements a middleware-like pattern for data validation and transformation.
   */
  public async mutate(mutation: StateMutation<T>, eventType: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const previousState = this.state;
      this.state = mutation(this.state);

      const event: DomainEvent = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        type: eventType,
        payload: this.state,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };

      this.history.push(event);
      this.emit('stateChanged', { event, previousState });
      this.emit(eventType, event);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', { type: 'MUTATION_FAILURE', error });
      throw new Error(`Domain Mutation Failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown'}`);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Data Handler: Orchestrates the ingestion and normalization of 
 * disparate data streams into the domain model.
 */
export class DataIngestionHandler {
  public static normalize(raw: any): Record<string, any> {
    return {
      ...raw,
      _processedAt: Date.now(),
      _correlationId: uuidv4(),
      _integrityHash: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(raw)).toString('base64').slice(0, 16)
    };
  }

  public static async processStream(stream: AsyncIterable<any>, service: LoomDomainService<any>): Promise<void> {
    for await (const chunk of stream) {
      const normalized = this.normalize(chunk);
      await service.mutate((s) => ({ ...s, ...normalized }), 'STREAM_INGESTION');
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Asynchronous Pipeline: Orchestrates complex business logic 
 * involving multiple domain services.
 */
export class OrchestrationPipeline {
  constructor(private readonly services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) {}

  public async executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, logic: (services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
    console.log(`[Pipeline] Initiating workflow: ${workflowId}`);
    try {
      await logic(this.services);
      console.log(`[Pipeline] Workflow ${workflowId} completed successfully.`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[Pipeline] Workflow ${workflowId} failed:`, err);
      throw err;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * State Mutation Algorithms: Pure functions for complex domain logic.
 */
export const DomainAlgorithms = {
  mergeState: <S>(base: S, patch: Partial<S>): S => ({ ...base, ...patch }),
  
  calculateResonance: (data: number[]): number => {
    return data.reduce((acc, val) => acc + Math.sin(val), 0) / data.length;
  },

  validateIntegrity: (state: any): boolean => {
    return state !== null && typeof state === 'object' && '_correlationId' in state;
  }
};

export default {
  LoomDomainService,
  DataIngestionHandler,
  OrchestrationPipeline,
  DomainAlgorithms
};

  (state: S): S;
}

/**
 * Core Domain Service: Manages the lifecycle of state transitions
 * and ensures atomic updates across the asynchronous pipeline.
 */
export class LoomDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  private state: T;
  private readonly history: DomainEvent[] = [];

  constructor(initialState: T) {
    super();
    this.state = initialState;
  }

  public getState(): T {
    return Object.freeze({ ...this.state });
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Implements a middleware-like pattern for data validation and transformation.
   */
  public async mutate(mutation: StateMutation<T>, eventType: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const previousState = this.state;
      this.state = mutation(this.state);

      const event: DomainEvent = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        type: eventType,
        payload: this.state,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };

      this.history.push(event);
      this.emit('stateChanged', { event, previousState });
      this.emit(eventType, event);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', { type: 'MUTATION_FAILURE', error });
      throw new Error(`Domain Mutation Failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown'}`);
    }
  }
}

/**

 * disparate data streams into the domain model.

  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {

      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {

      throw error;

    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  (state: S): S;
}

/**
 * Core Domain Service: Manages the lifecycle of state transitions
 * and ensures atomic updates across the asynchronous pipeline.
 */
export class LoomDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  private state: T;
  private readonly history: DomainEvent[] = [];

  constructor(initialState: T) {
    super();
    this.state = initialState;
  }

  public getState(): T {
    return Object.freeze({ ...this.state });
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Implements a middleware-like pattern for data validation and transformation.
   */
  public async mutate(mutation: StateMutation<T>, eventType: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const previousState = this.state;
      this.state = mutation(this.state);

      const event: DomainEvent = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        type: eventType,
        payload: this.state,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };

      this.history.push(event);
      this.emit('stateChanged', { event, previousState });
      this.emit(eventType, event);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', { type: 'MUTATION_FAILURE', error });
      throw new Error(`Domain Mutation Failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown'}`);
    }
  }
}

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';

// --- Types & Interfaces ---

export interface ThreadNode {
  id: string;
  frequency: number;
  resonance: number;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface LoomState {
  weaveId: string;
  nodes: Map<string, ThreadNode>;
  entropy: number;
  isStable: boolean;
}

// --- Core Domain Services ---

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

// --- Asynchronous Pipeline Handlers ---

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

// --- State Mutation Algorithms ---

/**
 * Algorithms for calculating the "Combination" of threads.
 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.
 */
export const calculateEmergentProperty = (nodes: ThreadNode[]): number => {
  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;
  
  const sumOfWeights = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + (1 / n.frequency), 0);
  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

/**
 * Data Handler for persisting weave state to the underlying storage layer.
 */
export class WeaveDataHandler {
  public static async persist(state: LoomState): Promise<boolean> {
    // Simulated I/O operation for production-grade persistence
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        console.log(`[Persistence] Weave ${state.weaveId} synchronized.`);
        resolve(true);
      }, 50);
    });
  }
}

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import/**
 * SEGMENT 2: Core Domain Services & State Mutation Logic
 * Orchestrates the "Loom" state machine, asynchronous event pipelines, 
 * and the fundamental data handlers for the reality-weave architecture.
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

// --- Types & Interfaces ---

export interface ThreadNode {
  id: string;
  frequency: number;
  resonance: number;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface LoomState {
  weaveId: string;
  nodes: Map<string, ThreadNode>;
  entropy: number;
  isStable: boolean;
}

// --- Core Domain Services ---

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

// --- Asynchronous Pipeline Handlers ---

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

// --- State Mutation Algorithms ---

/**
 * Algorithms for calculating the "Combination" of threads.
 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.
 */
export const calculateEmergentProperty = (nodes: ThreadNode[]): number => {
  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;
  
  const sumOfWeights = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + (1 / n.frequency), 0);
  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

/**
 * Data Handler for persisting weave state to the underlying storage layer.
 */
export class WeaveDataHandler {
  public static async persist(state: LoomState): Promise<boolean> {
    // Simulated I/O operation for production-grade persistence
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        console.log(`[Persistence] Weave ${state.weaveId} synchronized.`);
        resolve(true);
      }, 50);
    });
  }
}

// --- Exported Singleton for Orchestration ---

export const loomOrchestrator = new LoomService();
export const pipeline = new RealityPipeline();

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

// --- Types & Interfaces ---

export interface ThreadNode {
  id: string;
  frequency: number;
  resonance: number;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface LoomState {
  weaveId: string;
  nodes: Map<string, ThreadNode>;
  entropy: number;
  isStable: boolean;
}

// --- Core Domain Services ---

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

// --- Asynchronous Pipeline Handlers ---

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

// --- State Mutation Algorithms ---

/**
 * Algorithms for calculating the "Combination" of threads.
 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.
 */
export const calculateEmergentProperty = (nodes: ThreadNode[]): number => {
  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;
  
  const sumOfWeights = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + (1 / n.frequency), 0);
  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

/**
 * Data Handler for persisting weave state to the underlying storage layer.
 */
export class WeaveDataHandler {
  public static async persist(state: LoomState): Promise<boolean> {
    // Simulated I/O operation for production-grade persistence
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        console.log(`[Persistence] Weave ${state.weaveId} synchronized.`);
        resolve(true);
      }, 50);
    });
  }
}

// --- Exported Singleton for Orchestration ---

export const loomOrchestrator = new LoomService();
export const pipeline = new RealityPipeline();

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';

export interface DomainEvent<T = any> {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  payload: T;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface StateMutation<S> {
  (state: S): S;
}

/**
 * Core Domain Service: Manages the lifecycle of state transitions
 * and ensures atomic updates across the asynchronous pipeline.
 */
export class LoomDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  private state: T;
  private readonly history: DomainEvent[] = [];

  constructor(initialState: T) {
    super();
    this.state = initialState;
  }

  public getState(): T {
    return Object.freeze({ ...this.state });
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Implements a middleware-like pattern for data validation and transformation.
   */
  public async mutate(mutation: StateMutation<T>, eventType: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const previousState = this.state;
      this.state = mutation(this.state);

      const event: DomainEvent = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        type: eventType,
        payload: this.state,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };

      this.history.push(event);
      this.emit('stateChanged', { event, previousState });
      this.emit(eventType, event);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', { type: 'MUTATION_FAILURE', error });
      throw new Error(`Domain Mutation Failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown'}`);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Data Handler: Orchestrates the ingestion and normalization of 
 * disparate data streams into the domain model.
 */
export class DataIngestionHandler {
  public static normalize(raw: any): Record<string, any> {
    return {
      ...raw,
      _processedAt: Date.now(),
      _correlationId: uuidv4(),
      _integrityHash: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(raw)).toString('base64').slice(0, 16)
    };
  }

  public static async processStream(stream: AsyncIterable<any>, service: LoomDomainService<any>): Promise<void> {
    for await (const chunk of stream) {
      const normalized = this.normalize(chunk);
      await service.mutate((s) => ({ ...s, ...normalized }), 'STREAM_INGESTION');
    }
  }
}

}

export const DomainAlgorithms = {

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';

// --- Types & Interfaces ---

export interface ThreadNode {
  id: string;
  frequency: number;
  resonance: number;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface LoomState {
  weaveId: string;
  nodes: Map<string, ThreadNode>;
  entropy: number;

// --- Core Domain Services ---

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

// --- Asynchronous Pipeline Handlers ---

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

/**
 * Algorithms for calculating the "Combination" of threads.
 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.
 */
export const calculateEmergentProperty = (nodes: ThreadNode[]): number => {
  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;
  
  const sumOfWeights = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + (1 / n.frequency), 0);
  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

 * Data Handler for persisting weave state to the underlying storage layer.

export class WeaveDataHandler {

        console.log(`[Persistence] Weave ${state.weaveId} synchronized.`);
        resolve(true);
      }, 50);
    });
  }
}

export interface DomainEvent<T = any> {

  type: string;
  payload: T;

}

export interface StateMutation<S> {
  (state: S): S;
}

/**
 * Core Domain Service: Manages the lifecycle of state transitions
 * and ensures atomic updates across the asynchronous pipeline.
 */
export class LoomDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  private state: T;
  private readonly history: DomainEvent[] = [];

  constructor(initialState: T) {
    super();
    this.state = initialState;
  }

  public getState(): T {
    return Object.freeze({ ...this.state });
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Implements a middleware-like pattern for data validation and transformation.
   */
  public async mutate(mutation: StateMutation<T>, eventType: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const previousState = this.state;
      this.state = mutation(this.state);

      const event: DomainEvent = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        type: eventType,
        payload: this.state,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };

      this.history.push(event);
      this.emit('stateChanged', { event, previousState });
      this.emit(eventType, event);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', { type: 'MUTATION_FAILURE', error });
      throw new Error(`Domain Mutation Failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown'}`);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Data Handler: Orchestrates the ingestion and normalization of 
 * disparate data streams into the domain model.

    };
  }

  public static async processStream(stream: AsyncIterable<any>, service: LoomDomainService<any>): Promise<void> {
    for await (const chunk of stream) {

// --- Types & Interfaces ---

export interface ThreadNode {
  id: string;
  frequency: number;
  resonance: number;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface LoomState {
  weaveId: string;
  nodes: Map<string, ThreadNode>;
  entropy: number;
  isStable: boolean;
}

// --- Core Domain Services ---

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

// --- Asynchronous Pipeline Handlers ---

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

/**

 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.

  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;

  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

/**
 * Segment 3: Core Domain Services & Asynchronous Pipelines
 * Orchestrates state mutation, event-driven data handling, and domain logic.

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export interface DomainEvent<T = any> {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  payload: T;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface StateMutation<S> {
  (state: S): S;
}

/**
 * Core Domain Service: Manages the lifecycle of state transitions
 * and ensures atomic updates across the asynchronous pipeline.
 */
export class LoomDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  private state: T;
  private readonly history: DomainEvent[] = [];

  constructor(initialState: T) {
    super();
    this.state = initialState;
  }

  public getState(): T {
    return Object.freeze({ ...this.state });
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Implements a middleware-like pattern for data validation and transformation.
   */
  public async mutate(mutation: StateMutation<T>, eventType: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const previousState = this.state;
      this.state = mutation(this.state);

      const event: DomainEvent = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        type: eventType,
        payload: this.state,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };

      this.history.push(event);
      this.emit('stateChanged', { event, previousState });
      this.emit(eventType, event);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', { type: 'MUTATION_FAILURE', error });
      throw new Error(`Domain Mutation Failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown'}`);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Data Handler: Orchestrates the ingestion and normalization of 
 * disparate data streams into the domain model.
 */
export class DataIngestionHandler {
  public static normalize(raw: any): Record<string, any> {
    return {
      ...raw,
      _processedAt: Date.now(),
      _correlationId: uuidv4(),
      _integrityHash: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(raw)).toString('base64').slice(0, 16)
    };
  }

  public static async processStream(stream: AsyncIterable<any>, service: LoomDomainService<any>): Promise<void> {
    for await (const chunk of stream) {
      const normalized = this.normalize(chunk);
      await service.mutate((s) => ({ ...s, ...normalized }), 'STREAM_INGESTION');
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Asynchronous Pipeline: Orchestrates complex business logic 
 * involving multiple domain services.
 */
export class OrchestrationPipeline {
  constructor(private readonly services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) {}

  public async executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, logic: (services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
    console.log(`[Pipeline] Initiating workflow: ${workflowId}`);
    try {
      await logic(this.services);
      console.log(`[Pipeline] Workflow ${workflowId} completed successfully.`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[Pipeline] Workflow ${workflowId} failed:`, err);
      throw err;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * State Mutation Algorithms: Pure functions for complex domain logic.
 */
export const DomainAlgorithms = {
  mergeState: <S>(base: S, patch: Partial<S>): S => ({ ...base, ...patch }),
  
  calculateResonance: (data: number[]): number => {
    return data.reduce((acc, val) => acc + Math.sin(val), 0) / data.length;
  },

  validateIntegrity: (state: any): boolean => {
    return state !== null && typeof state === 'object' && '_correlationId' in state;
  }
};

export default {
  LoomDomainService,
  DataIngestionHandler,
  OrchestrationPipeline,
  DomainAlgorithms
};

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';

// --- Types & Interfaces ---

export interface ThreadNode {
  id: string;
  frequency: number;
  resonance: number;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface LoomState {
  weaveId: string;

  entropy: number;
  isStable: boolean;
}

// --- Core Domain Services ---

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

// --- Asynchronous Pipeline Handlers ---

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

// --- State Mutation Algorithms ---

/**
 * Algorithms for calculating the "Combination" of threads.
 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.
 */
export const calculateEmergentProperty = (nodes: ThreadNode[]): number => {
  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;
  
  const sumOfWeights = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + (1 / n.frequency), 0);
  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

 * Data Handler for persisting weave state to the underlying storage layer.

export class WeaveDataHandler {

    // Simulated I/O operation for production-grade persistence

      setTimeout(() => {
        console.log(`[Persistence] Weave ${state.weaveId} synchronized.`);
        resolve(true);
      }, 50);
    });
  }
}

  private state: T;
  private readonly history: DomainEvent[] = [];

    this.state = initialState;
  }

  public getState(): T {
    return Object.freeze({ ...this.state });
  }

  /**

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';

// --- Types & Interfaces ---

export interface ThreadNode {
  id: string;
  frequency: number;
  resonance: number;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface LoomState {
  weaveId: string;
  nodes: Map<string, ThreadNode>;
  entropy: number;
  isStable: boolean;
}

// --- Core Domain Services ---

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

// --- Asynchronous Pipeline Handlers ---

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

// --- State Mutation Algorithms ---

/**
 * Algorithms for calculating the "Combination" of threads.
 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.
 */
export const calculateEmergentProperty = (nodes: ThreadNode[]): number => {
  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;
  
  const sumOfWeights = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + (1 / n.frequency), 0);
  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

/**
 * Data Handler for persisting weave state to the underlying storage layer.
 */
export class WeaveDataHandler {
  public static async persist(state: LoomState): Promise<boolean> {
    // Simulated I/O operation for production-grade persistence
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        console.log(`[Persistence] Weave ${state.weaveId} synchronized.`);
        resolve(true);
      }, 50);
    });
  }
}

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export interface DomainEvent<T = any> {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  payload: T;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface StateMutation<S> {
  (state: S): S;
}

/**
 * Core Domain Service: Manages the lifecycle of state transitions
 * and ensures atomic updates across the asynchronous pipeline.
 */
export class LoomDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  private state: T;
  private readonly history: DomainEvent[] = [];

  constructor(initialState: T) {
    super();
    this.state = initialState;
  }

  public getState(): T {
    return Object.freeze({ ...this.state });
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Implements a middleware-like pattern for data validation and transformation.
   */
  public async mutate(mutation: StateMutation<T>, eventType: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const previousState = this.state;
      this.state = mutation(this.state);

      const event: DomainEvent = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        type: eventType,
        payload: this.state,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };

      this.history.push(event);
      this.emit('stateChanged', { event, previousState });
      this.emit(eventType, event);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', { type: 'MUTATION_FAILURE', error });
      throw new Error(`Domain Mutation Failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown'}`);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Data Handler: Orchestrates the ingestion and normalization of 
 * disparate data streams into the domain model.
 */
export class DataIngestionHandler {
  public static normalize(raw: any): Record<string, any> {
    return {
      ...raw,
      _processedAt: Date.now(),
      _correlationId: uuidv4(),
      _integrityHash: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(raw)).toString('base64').slice(0, 16)
    };
  }

  public static async processStream(stream: AsyncIterable<any>, service: LoomDomainService<any>): Promise<void> {
    for await (const chunk of stream) {
      const normalized = this.normalize(chunk);
      await service.mutate((s) => ({ ...s, ...normalized }), 'STREAM_INGESTION');
    }
  }
}

 * Asynchronous Pipeline: Orchestrates complex business logic 
 * involving multiple domain services.
 */
export class OrchestrationPipeline {
  constructor(private readonly services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) {}

  public async executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, logic: (services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
    console.log(`[Pipeline] Initiating workflow: ${workflowId}`);
    try {
      await logic(this.services);
      console.log(`[Pipeline] Workflow ${workflowId} completed successfully.`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[Pipeline] Workflow ${workflowId} failed:`, err);
      throw err;
    }
  }
}

 * State Mutation Algorithms: Pure functions for complex domain logic.
 */
export const DomainAlgorithms = {
  mergeState: <S>(base: S, patch: Partial<S>): S => ({ ...base, ...patch }),

  },

  validateIntegrity: (state: any): boolean => {

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';

// --- Types & Interfaces ---

export interface ThreadNode {
  id: string;
  frequency: number;
  resonance: number;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface LoomState {
  weaveId: string;
  nodes: Map<string, ThreadNode>;
  entropy: number;
  isStable: boolean;
}

// --- Core Domain Services ---

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

// --- Asynchronous Pipeline Handlers ---

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

/**
 * Algorithms for calculating the "Combination" of threads.
 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.
 */
export const calculateEmergentProperty = (nodes: ThreadNode[]): number => {
  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;
  
  const sumOfWeights = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + (1 / n.frequency), 0);
  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

      setTimeout(() => {
        console.log(`[Persistence] Weave ${state.weaveId} synchronized.`);
        resolve(true);
      }, 50);
    });
  }
}

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';

// --- Types & Interfaces ---

export interface ThreadNode {
  id: string;
  frequency: number;
  resonance: number;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface LoomState {
  weaveId: string;
  nodes: Map<string, ThreadNode>;
  entropy: number;
  isStable: boolean;
}

// --- Core Domain Services ---

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

// --- Asynchronous Pipeline Handlers ---

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

/**
 * Algorithms for calculating the "Combination" of threads.
 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.
 */
export const calculateEmergentProperty = (nodes: ThreadNode[]): number => {
  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;
  
  const sumOfWeights = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + (1 / n.frequency), 0);
  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

/**

export class WeaveDataHandler {
  public static async persist(state: LoomState): Promise<boolean> {
    // Simulated I/O operation for production-grade persistence

      setTimeout(() => {
        console.log(`[Persistence] Weave ${state.weaveId} synchronized.`);
        resolve(true);
      }, 50);
    });
  }
}
