export interface LoomState {
  id: string;
  layer: 'phenomenal' | 'noumenal' | 'transcendent';
  resonance: number;
  threads: Map<string, ThreadMetadata>;
  lastMutation: number;
}

export interface ThreadMetadata {
  origin: string;
  weight: number;
  entanglementId: string | null;
}

export class LoomEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;
  private readonly mutationQueue: Array<(s: LoomState) => LoomState> = [];

  constructor(initialLayer: LoomState['layer'] = 'phenomenal') {
    super();
    this.state = {
      id: uuidv4(),
      layer: initialLayer,
      resonance: 0.5,
      threads: new Map(),
      lastMutation: Date.now(),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Ensures atomic updates to the reality-scape.
   */
  public async mutateState(transform: (s: LoomState) => LoomState): Promise<LoomState> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      try {
        this.mutationQueue.push(transform);
        this.processQueue();
        resolve(this.state);
      } catch (error) {
        this.emit('error', error);
        reject(error);
      }
    });
  }

  private processQueue(): void {
    while (this.mutationQueue.length > 0) {
      const transform = this.mutationQueue.shift();
      if (transform) {
        this.state = transform({ ...this.state });
        this.state.lastMutation = Date.now();
        this.emit('stateChanged', this.state);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Core Domain Service: Thread Entanglement
   * Logic for linking disparate data points across the tapestry.
   */
  public entangleThreads(threadA: string, threadB: string): void {
    const entanglementId = uuidv4();
    this.mutateState((s) => {
      const tA = s.threads.get(threadA) || { origin: 'void', weight: 1, entanglementId: null };
      const tB = s.threads.get(threadB) || { origin: 'void', weight: 1, entanglementId: null };
      
      s.threads.set(threadA, { ...tA, entanglementId });
      s.threads.set(threadB, { ...tB, entanglementId });
      return s;
    });
  }

  /**
   * Business Logic: Resonance Calibration
   * Adjusts the systemic frequency based on observer input.
   */
  public calibrateResonance(delta: number): void {
    this.mutateState((s) => {
      s.resonance = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s.resonance + delta));
      return s;
    });
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, threads: new Map(this.state.threads) };
  }
}

/**
 * Data Handler: Reality Stream Processor
 * Manages the flow of noumenal data into phenomenal structures.
 */
export class RealityStreamProcessor {
  private engine: LoomEngine;

  constructor(engine: LoomEngine) {
    this.engine = engine;
  }

  public async ingest(data: Record<string, any>): Promise<void> {
    await this.engine.mutateState((s) => {
      const threadId = uuidv4();
      s.threads.set(threadId, {
        origin: 'external_input',
        weight: data.intensity || 1,
        entanglementId: null
      });
      return s;
    });
  }
}

export const createLoomService = () => {
  const engine = new LoomEngine();
  const processor = new RealityStreamProcessor(engine);
  return { engine, processor };
};

/**
 * Core Domain Services: Asynchronous Pipeline & State Mutation Engine
 * Part 5: Orchestration of the Loom's Internal State Transitions
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export interface StateMutation<T> {
  id: string;
  payload: T;
  timestamp: number;
  priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
}

export interface PipelineContext {
  correlationId: string;
  depth: number;
  trace: string[];
}

export abstract class BaseDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  protected readonly _stateRegistry: Map<string, T> = new Map();
  protected readonly _mutationQueue: StateMutation<T>[] = [];

  constructor(protected readonly serviceName: string) {
    super();
  }

  public abstract processMutation(mutation: StateMutation<T>): Promise<void>;

  protected async emitStateChange(id: string, data: T): Promise<void> {
    this.emit('stateUpdated', { id, data, timestamp: Date.now() });
  }
}

export class LoomStateOrchestrator extends BaseDomainService<any> {
  private _isProcessing: boolean = false;

  constructor() {
    super('LoomStateOrchestrator');
  }

  public async processMutation(mutation: StateMutation<any>): Promise<void> {
    this._mutationQueue.push(mutation);
    this._mutationQueue.sort((a, b) => (a.priority === 'critical' ? -1 : 1));
    await this.flushQueue();
  }

  private async flushQueue(): Promise<void> {
    if (this._isProcessing) return;
    this._isProcessing = true;

    try {
      while (this._mutationQueue.length > 0) {
        const mutation = this._mutationQueue.shift();
        if (!mutation) continue;

        await this.executeAtomicTransition(mutation);
      }
    } finally {
      this._isProcessing = false;
    }
  }

  private async executeAtomicTransition(mutation: StateMutation<any>): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      try {
        const currentState = this._stateRegistry.get(mutation.id) || {};
        const nextState = { ...currentState, ...mutation.payload, _lastModified: mutation.timestamp };
        
        this._stateRegistry.set(mutation.id, nextState);
        this.emitStateChange(mutation.id, nextState);
        resolve();
      } catch (error) {
        reject(new Error(`Atomic Transition Failed: ${error}`));
      }
    });
  }
}

export class AsyncPipelineHandler {
  private static instance: AsyncPipelineHandler;
  private orchestrator: LoomStateOrchestrator = new LoomStateOrchestrator();

  private constructor() {}

  public static getInstance(): AsyncPipelineHandler {
    if (!this.instance) this.instance = new AsyncPipelineHandler();
    return this.instance;
  }

  public async executePipeline<T>(
    data: T, 
    context: PipelineContext, 
    transform: (d: T) => Promise<T>
  ): Promise<T> {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    
    try {
      const transformed = await transform(data);
      
      await this.orchestrator.processMutation({
        id: context.correlationId,
        payload: transformed,
        timestamp: startTime,
        priority: 'medium'
      });

      return transformed;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[Pipeline Error] Context: ${context.correlationId}`, err);
      throw err;
    }
  }
}

export const StateMutationFactory = {
  create: <T>(payload: T, priority: StateMutation<T>['priority'] = 'medium'): StateMutation<T> => ({
    id: uuidv4(),
    payload,
    timestamp: Date.now(),
    priority
  })
};

export default {
  LoomStateOrchestrator,
  AsyncPipelineHandler,
  StateMutationFactory
};

 * Segment 7: UI Component Presentation, Hook Handlers, Export Declarations, and File Termination.
 * This segment provides the final orchestration layer for the "Loom of Existence" application,
 * implementing the React-based presentation layer, state synchronization, and module exports.

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useLoomContext } from './LoomContext';
import { RealityEngine } from './RealityEngine';

/**
 * RealityPresentationLayer: The primary UI component that renders the 
 * "Loom of Existence" narrative interface.
 */
export const RealityPresentationLayer: React.FC = () => {
  const { state, dispatch } = useLoomContext();
  const [isVeilThin, setIsVeilThin] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Hook Handler: Orchestrates the transition between narrative states
  const handleVeilInteraction = useCallback((event: React.MouseEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setIsVeilThin((prev) => !prev);
    dispatch({ type: 'TOGGLE_PERCEPTION_DEPTH', payload: !isVeilThin });
  }, [dispatch, isVeilThin]);

  // Hook Handler: Synchronizes the engine state with the UI
  useEffect(() => {
    const engine = new RealityEngine();
    const subscription = engine.observe((update) => {
      dispatch({ type: 'SYNC_COSMIC_THREADS', payload: update });
    });

    return () => {
      subscription.unsubscribe();
      engine.dispose();
    };
  }, [dispatch]);

  // Memoized rendering of the narrative tapestry
  const renderedTapestry = useMemo(() => {
    return state.threads.map((thread, index) => (
      <div key={`thread-${index}`} className={`tapestry-node ${isVeilThin ? 'resonant' : 'static'}`}>
        <h3>{thread.title}</h3>
        <p>{thread.content}</p>
      </div>
    ));
  }, [state.threads, isVeilThin]);

  return (
    <section className="loom-container" aria-label="The Chronicle of Unseen Weaves">
      <header>
        <h1>The Loom of Existence</h1>
        <button onClick={handleVeilInteraction} aria-pressed={isVeilThin}>
          {isVeilThin ? 'The Veil is Thin' : 'Peer Beyond the Veil'}
        </button>
      </header>
      <main className="tapestry-grid">
        {renderedTapestry}
      </main>
      <footer className="epilogue">
        <p>The weave continues... always.</p>
      </footer>
    </section>
  );
};

// --- Types & Interfaces ---

export interface ThreadNode {
  id: string;

  resonance: number;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
}

  weaveId: string;

// --- Core Domain Services ---

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

// --- Asynchronous Pipeline Handlers ---

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

// --- State Mutation Algorithms ---

/**
 * Algorithms for calculating the "Combination" of threads.
 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.
 */
export const calculateEmergentProperty = (nodes: ThreadNode[]): number => {
  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;
  
  const sumOfWeights = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + (1 / n.frequency), 0);
  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

        resolve(true);
      }, 50);
    });
  }
}

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';

export interface DomainEvent<T = any> {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  payload: T;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface StateMutation<S> {
  (state: S): S;
}

/**
 * Core Domain Service: Manages the lifecycle of state transitions
 * and ensures atomic updates across the asynchronous pipeline.
 */
export class LoomDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  private state: T;
  private readonly history: DomainEvent[] = [];

  constructor(initialState: T) {
    super();
    this.state = initialState;
  }

  public getState(): T {
    return Object.freeze({ ...this.state });
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Implements a middleware-like pattern for data validation and transformation.
   */
  public async mutate(mutation: StateMutation<T>, eventType: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const previousState = this.state;
      this.state = mutation(this.state);

      const event: DomainEvent = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        type: eventType,
        payload: this.state,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };

      this.history.push(event);
      this.emit('stateChanged', { event, previousState });
      this.emit(eventType, event);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', { type: 'MUTATION_FAILURE', error });
      throw new Error(`Domain Mutation Failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown'}`);
    }
  }
}

 * Data Handler: Orchestrates the ingestion and normalization of

    };
  }

  public static async processStream(stream: AsyncIterable<any>, service: LoomDomainService<any>): Promise<void> {
    for await (const chunk of stream) {
      const normalized = this.normalize(chunk);
      await service.mutate((s) => ({ ...s, ...normalized }), 'STREAM_INGESTION');
    }
  }
}

 */

  constructor(private readonly services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) {}

  public async executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, logic: (services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {

      throw err;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * State Mutation Algorithms: Pure functions for complex domain logic.
 */
export const DomainAlgorithms = {
  mergeState: <S>(base: S, patch: Partial<S>): S => ({ ...base, ...patch }),
  
  calculateResonance: (data: number[]): number => {
    return data.reduce((acc, val) => acc + Math.sin(val), 0) / data.length;
  },

  validateIntegrity: (state: any): boolean => {

export class LoomCoreService extends EventEmitter {

  private pipelineQueue: MutationEvent[] = [];

  public queueMutation(event: MutationEvent): void {

    try {
      const targetId = event.payload.id;
      if (!targetId || !this.stateRegistry.has(targetId)) {
        throw new Error(`Invalid state reference: ${targetId}`);
      }

      const currentState = this.stateRegistry.get(targetId)!;
      const mutatedState = this.applyAlgorithm(currentState, event);
      
      this.stateRegistry.set(targetId, mutatedState);
      this.emit('mutationApplied', mutatedState);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
    }
  }

  private applyAlgorithm(state: RealityState, event: MutationEvent): RealityState {
    // Core State Mutation Logic: Entropy-Coherence Balancing
    const delta = event.type === 'STABILIZE' ? 0.05 : -0.05;
    
    return {
      ...state,
      ...event.payload,
      coherence: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, state.coherence + delta)),
      entropy: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, state.entropy - delta)),
      timestamp: Date.now()
    };
  }

  public getSnapshot(id: string): RealityState | undefined {
    return this.stateRegistry.get(id);
  }
}

export class AsyncRealityPipeline {
  private core: LoomCoreService = LoomCoreService.getInstance();

  public async executeTransformation(id: string, intensity: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.core.queueMutation({
        type: 'RESONATE',
        payload: { id, coherence: intensity },
        priority: 10
      });
      
      this.core.once('mutationApplied', (state) => {
        if (state.id === id) resolve();
      });
      
      setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Pipeline Timeout')), 5000);
    });
  }
}

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';

export interface LoomState {
  id: string;
  layer: 'phenomenal' | 'noumenal' | 'transcendent';
  resonance: number;
  threads: Map<string, ThreadMetadata>;
  lastMutation: number;
}

export interface ThreadMetadata {
  origin: string;
  weight: number;
  entanglementId: string | null;
}

export class LoomEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;
  private readonly mutationQueue: Array<(s: LoomState) => LoomState> = [];

  constructor(initialLayer: LoomState['layer'] = 'phenomenal') {
    super();
    this.state = {
      id: uuidv4(),
      layer: initialLayer,
      resonance: 0.5,
      threads: new Map(),
      lastMutation: Date.now(),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Ensures atomic updates to the reality-scape.
   */
  public async mutateState(transform: (s: LoomState) => LoomState): Promise<LoomState> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      try {
        this.mutationQueue.push(transform);
        this.processQueue();
        resolve(this.state);
      } catch (error) {
        this.emit('error', error);
        reject(error);
      }
    });
  }

  private processQueue(): void {
    while (this.mutationQueue.length > 0) {
      const transform = this.mutationQueue.shift();
      if (transform) {
        this.state = transform({ ...this.state });
        this.state.lastMutation = Date.now();
        this.emit('stateChanged', this.state);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Core Domain Service: Thread Entanglement
   * Logic for linking disparate data points across the tapestry.
   */
  public entangleThreads(threadA: string, threadB: string): void {
    const entanglementId = uuidv4();
    this.mutateState((s) => {
      const tA = s.threads.get(threadA) || { origin: 'void', weight: 1, entanglementId: null };
      const tB = s.threads.get(threadB) || { origin: 'void', weight: 1, entanglementId: null };
      
      s.threads.set(threadA, { ...tA, entanglementId });
      s.threads.set(threadB, { ...tB, entanglementId });
      return s;
    });
  }

  /**
   * Business Logic: Resonance Calibration
   * Adjusts the systemic frequency based on observer input.
   */
  public calibrateResonance(delta: number): void {
    this.mutateState((s) => {
      s.resonance = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s.resonance + delta));
      return s;
    });
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, threads: new Map(this.state.threads) };
  }
}

/**
 * Data Handler: Reality Stream Processor
 * Manages the flow of noumenal data into phenomenal structures.
 */
export class RealityStreamProcessor {
  private engine: LoomEngine;

  constructor(engine: LoomEngine) {
    this.engine = engine;
  }

  public async ingest(data: Record<string, any>): Promise<void> {
    await this.engine.mutateState((s) => {
      const threadId = uuidv4();
      s.threads.set(threadId, {
        origin: 'external_input',
        weight: data.intensity || 1,
        entanglementId: null
      });
      return s;
    });
  }
}

export const createLoomService = () => {
  const engine = new LoomEngine();
  const processor = new RealityStreamProcessor(engine);
  return { engine, processor };
};

/**
 * Core Domain Services: Asynchronous Pipeline & State Mutation Engine
 * Part 5: Orchestration of the Loom's Internal State Transitions
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export interface StateMutation<T> {
  id: string;
  payload: T;
  timestamp: number;
  priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
}

export interface PipelineContext {
  correlationId: string;
  depth: number;
  trace: string[];
}

export abstract class BaseDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  protected readonly _stateRegistry: Map<string, T> = new Map();
  protected readonly _mutationQueue: StateMutation<T>[] = [];

  constructor(protected readonly serviceName: string) {
    super();
  }

  public abstract processMutation(mutation: StateMutation<T>): Promise<void>;

  protected async emitStateChange(id: string, data: T): Promise<void> {
    this.emit('stateUpdated', { id, data, timestamp: Date.now() });
  }
}

export class LoomStateOrchestrator extends BaseDomainService<any> {
  private _isProcessing: boolean = false;

  constructor() {
    super('LoomStateOrchestrator');
  }

  public async processMutation(mutation: StateMutation<any>): Promise<void> {
    this._mutationQueue.push(mutation);
    this._mutationQueue.sort((a, b) => (a.priority === 'critical' ? -1 : 1));
    await this.flushQueue();
  }

  private async flushQueue(): Promise<void> {
    if (this._isProcessing) return;
    this._isProcessing = true;

    try {
      while (this._mutationQueue.length > 0) {
        const mutation = this._mutationQueue.shift();
        if (!mutation) continue;

        await this.executeAtomicTransition(mutation);
      }
    } finally {
      this._isProcessing = false;
    }
  }

  private async executeAtomicTransition(mutation: StateMutation<any>): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      try {
        const currentState = this._stateRegistry.get(mutation.id) || {};
        const nextState = { ...currentState, ...mutation.payload, _lastModified: mutation.timestamp };
        
        this._stateRegistry.set(mutation.id, nextState);
        this.emitStateChange(mutation.id, nextState);
        resolve();
      } catch (error) {
        reject(new Error(`Atomic Transition Failed: ${error}`));
      }
    });
  }
}

export class AsyncPipelineHandler {
  private static instance: AsyncPipelineHandler;
  private orchestrator: LoomStateOrchestrator = new LoomStateOrchestrator();

  private constructor() {}

  public static getInstance(): AsyncPipelineHandler {
    if (!this.instance) this.instance = new AsyncPipelineHandler();
    return this.instance;
  }

  public async executePipeline<T>(
    data: T, 
    context: PipelineContext, 
    transform: (d: T) => Promise<T>
  ): Promise<T> {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    
    try {
      const transformed = await transform(data);
      
      await this.orchestrator.processMutation({
        id: context.correlationId,
        payload: transformed,
        timestamp: startTime,
        priority: 'medium'
      });

      return transformed;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[Pipeline Error] Context: ${context.correlationId}`, err);
      throw err;
    }
  }
}

export const StateMutationFactory = {
  create: <T>(payload: T, priority: StateMutation<T>['priority'] = 'medium'): StateMutation<T> => ({
    id: uuidv4(),
    payload,
    timestamp: Date.now(),
    priority
  })
};

export default {
  LoomStateOrchestrator,
  AsyncPipelineHandler,
  StateMutationFactory
};

/**
 * Segment 7: UI Component Presentation, Hook Handlers, Export Declarations, and File Termination.
 * This segment provides the final orchestration layer for the "Loom of Existence" application,
 * implementing the React-based presentation layer, state synchronization, and module exports.
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useLoomContext } from './LoomContext';
import { RealityEngine } from './RealityEngine';

/**
 * RealityPresentationLayer: The primary UI component that renders the 
 * "Loom of Existence" narrative interface.
 */
export const RealityPresentationLayer: React.FC = () => {
  const { state, dispatch } = useLoomContext();
  const [isVeilThin, setIsVeilThin] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Hook Handler: Orchestrates the transition between narrative states
  const handleVeilInteraction = useCallback((event: React.MouseEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setIsVeilThin((prev) => !prev);
    dispatch({ type: 'TOGGLE_PERCEPTION_DEPTH', payload: !isVeilThin });
  }, [dispatch, isVeilThin]);

  // Hook Handler: Synchronizes the engine state with the UI
  useEffect(() => {
    const engine = new RealityEngine();
    const subscription = engine.observe((update) => {
      dispatch({ type: 'SYNC_COSMIC_THREADS', payload: update });
    });

    return () => {
      subscription.unsubscribe();
      engine.dispose();
    };
  }, [dispatch]);

  // Memoized rendering of the narrative tapestry
  const renderedTapestry = useMemo(() => {
    return state.threads.map((thread, index) => (
      <div key={`thread-${index}`} className={`tapestry-node ${isVeilThin ? 'resonant' : 'static'}`}>
        <h3>{thread.title}</h3>
        <p>{thread.content}</p>
      </div>
    ));
  }, [state.threads, isVeilThin]);

  return (
    <section className="loom-container" aria-label="The Chronicle of Unseen Weaves">
      <header>
        <h1>The Loom of Existence</h1>
        <button onClick={handleVeilInteraction} aria-pressed={isVeilThin}>
          {isVeilThin ? 'The Veil is Thin' : 'Peer Beyond the Veil'}
        </button>
      </header>
      <main className="tapestry-grid">
        {renderedTapestry}
      </main>
      <footer className="epilogue">
        <p>The weave continues... always.</p>
      </footer>
    </section>
  );
};

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';

// --- Types & Interfaces ---

export interface ThreadNode {
  id: string;
  frequency: number;
  resonance: number;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface LoomState {
  weaveId: string;

}

// --- Core Domain Services ---

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

// --- Asynchronous Pipeline Handlers ---

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

// --- State Mutation Algorithms ---

/**
 * Algorithms for calculating the "Combination" of threads.
 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.
 */
export const calculateEmergentProperty = (nodes: ThreadNode[]): number => {
  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;
  
  const sumOfWeights = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + (1 / n.frequency), 0);
  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

        resolve(true);
      }, 50);
    });
  }
}

 * Orchestrates state mutation, event-driven data handling, and domain logic.

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export interface DomainEvent<T = any> {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  payload: T;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface StateMutation<S> {
  (state: S): S;
}

/**
 * Core Domain Service: Manages the lifecycle of state transitions
 * and ensures atomic updates across the asynchronous pipeline.
 */
export class LoomDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  private state: T;
  private readonly history: DomainEvent[] = [];

  constructor(initialState: T) {
    super();
    this.state = initialState;
  }

  public getState(): T {
    return Object.freeze({ ...this.state });
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Implements a middleware-like pattern for data validation and transformation.
   */
  public async mutate(mutation: StateMutation<T>, eventType: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const previousState = this.state;
      this.state = mutation(this.state);

      const event: DomainEvent = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        type: eventType,
        payload: this.state,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };

      this.history.push(event);
      this.emit('stateChanged', { event, previousState });
      this.emit(eventType, event);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', { type: 'MUTATION_FAILURE', error });
      throw new Error(`Domain Mutation Failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown'}`);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Data Handler: Orchestrates the ingestion and normalization of 
 * disparate data streams into the domain model.
 */
export class DataIngestionHandler {
  public static normalize(raw: any): Record<string, any> {
    return {
      ...raw,
      _processedAt: Date.now(),
      _correlationId: uuidv4(),
      _integrityHash: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(raw)).toString('base64').slice(0, 16)
    };
  }

  public static async processStream(stream: AsyncIterable<any>, service: LoomDomainService<any>): Promise<void> {
    for await (const chunk of stream) {
      const normalized = this.normalize(chunk);
      await service.mutate((s) => ({ ...s, ...normalized }), 'STREAM_INGESTION');
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Asynchronous Pipeline: Orchestrates complex business logic 
 * involving multiple domain services.
 */
export class OrchestrationPipeline {
  constructor(private readonly services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) {}

  public async executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, logic: (services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
    console.log(`[Pipeline] Initiating workflow: ${workflowId}`);
    try {
      await logic(this.services);
      console.log(`[Pipeline] Workflow ${workflowId} completed successfully.`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[Pipeline] Workflow ${workflowId} failed:`, err);
      throw err;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * State Mutation Algorithms: Pure functions for complex domain logic.
 */
export const DomainAlgorithms = {
  mergeState: <S>(base: S, patch: Partial<S>): S => ({ ...base, ...patch }),
  
  calculateResonance: (data: number[]): number => {
    return data.reduce((acc, val) => acc + Math.sin(val), 0) / data.length;
  },

  validateIntegrity: (state: any): boolean => {
    return state !== null && typeof state === 'object' && '_correlationId' in state;
  }
};

export default {
  LoomDomainService,
  DataIngestionHandler,
  OrchestrationPipeline,
  DomainAlgorithms
};

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';

export interface RealityState {
  id: string;
  layer: number;
  coherence: number;
  entropy: number;
  manifestation: Record<string, any>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface MutationEvent {
  type: 'STABILIZE' | 'RESONATE' | 'DISSOLVE';
  payload: Partial<RealityState>;
  priority: number;
}

export class LoomCoreService extends EventEmitter {
  private static instance: LoomCoreService;
  private stateRegistry: Map<string, RealityState> = new Map();
  private pipelineQueue: MutationEvent[] = [];

  private constructor() {
    super();
    this.initializePipeline();
  }

  public static getInstance(): LoomCoreService {
    if (!LoomCoreService.instance) {
      LoomCoreService.instance = new LoomCoreService();
    }
    return LoomCoreService.instance;
  }

  private initializePipeline(): void {
    setInterval(async () => {
      if (this.pipelineQueue.length > 0) {
        const event = this.pipelineQueue.shift();
        if (event) await this.processMutation(event);
      }
    }, 16); // 60Hz tick rate for reality simulation
  }

  public async commitState(state: Omit<RealityState, 'id' | 'timestamp'>): Promise<string> {
    const id = uuidv4();
    const newState: RealityState = {
      ...state,
      id,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    };
    this.stateRegistry.set(id, newState);
    this.emit('stateChanged', newState);
    return id;
  }

  public queueMutation(event: MutationEvent): void {
    this.pipelineQueue.push(event);
    this.pipelineQueue.sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority);
  }

  private async processMutation(event: MutationEvent): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const targetId = event.payload.id;
      if (!targetId || !this.stateRegistry.has(targetId)) {
        throw new Error(`Invalid state reference: ${targetId}`);
      }

      const currentState = this.stateRegistry.get(targetId)!;
      const mutatedState = this.applyAlgorithm(currentState, event);
      
      this.stateRegistry.set(targetId, mutatedState);
      this.emit('mutationApplied', mutatedState);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
    }
  }

  private applyAlgorithm(state: RealityState, event: MutationEvent): RealityState {
    // Core State Mutation Logic: Entropy-Coherence Balancing
    const delta = event.type === 'STABILIZE' ? 0.05 : -0.05;
    
    return {
      ...state,
      ...event.payload,
      coherence: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, state.coherence + delta)),
      entropy: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, state.entropy - delta)),
      timestamp: Date.now()
    };
  }

  public getSnapshot(id: string): RealityState | undefined {
    return this.stateRegistry.get(id);
  }
}

export class AsyncRealityPipeline {
  private core: LoomCoreService = LoomCoreService.getInstance();

  public async executeTransformation(id: string, intensity: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.core.queueMutation({
        type: 'RESONATE',
        payload: { id, coherence: intensity },
        priority: 10
      });
      
      this.core.once('mutationApplied', (state) => {
        if (state.id === id) resolve();
      });
      
      setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Pipeline Timeout')), 5000);
    });
  }
}

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';

export interface LoomState {
  id: string;
  layer: 'phenomenal' | 'noumenal' | 'transcendent';

  threads: Map<string, ThreadMetadata>;
  lastMutation: number;
}

export interface ThreadMetadata {

  entanglementId: string | null;
}

export class LoomEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;
  private readonly mutationQueue: Array<(s: LoomState) => LoomState> = [];

  constructor(initialLayer: LoomState['layer'] = 'phenomenal') {
    super();
    this.state = {
      id: uuidv4(),
      layer: initialLayer,
      resonance: 0.5,
      threads: new Map(),
      lastMutation: Date.now(),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Ensures atomic updates to the reality-scape.
   */
  public async mutateState(transform: (s: LoomState) => LoomState): Promise<LoomState> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      try {
        this.mutationQueue.push(transform);
        this.processQueue();
        resolve(this.state);
      } catch (error) {
        this.emit('error', error);
        reject(error);
      }
    });
  }

  private processQueue(): void {
    while (this.mutationQueue.length > 0) {
      const transform = this.mutationQueue.shift();
      if (transform) {
        this.state = transform({ ...this.state });
        this.state.lastMutation = Date.now();
        this.emit('stateChanged', this.state);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Core Domain Service: Thread Entanglement
   * Logic for linking disparate data points across the tapestry.
   */
  public entangleThreads(threadA: string, threadB: string): void {
    const entanglementId = uuidv4();
    this.mutateState((s) => {
      const tA = s.threads.get(threadA) || { origin: 'void', weight: 1, entanglementId: null };
      const tB = s.threads.get(threadB) || { origin: 'void', weight: 1, entanglementId: null };
      
      s.threads.set(threadA, { ...tA, entanglementId });
      s.threads.set(threadB, { ...tB, entanglementId });
      return s;
    });
  }

  /**
   * Business Logic: Resonance Calibration
   * Adjusts the systemic frequency based on observer input.
   */
  public calibrateResonance(delta: number): void {
    this.mutateState((s) => {
      s.resonance = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s.resonance + delta));
      return s;
    });
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, threads: new Map(this.state.threads) };
  }
}

/**
 * Core Domain Services: Asynchronous Pipeline & State Mutation Engine
 * Part 5: Orchestration of the Loom's Internal State Transitions
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export interface StateMutation<T> {
  id: string;
  payload: T;
  timestamp: number;
  priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
}

export interface PipelineContext {
  correlationId: string;
  depth: number;
  trace: string[];
}

export abstract class BaseDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  protected readonly _stateRegistry: Map<string, T> = new Map();
  protected readonly _mutationQueue: StateMutation<T>[] = [];

  constructor(protected readonly serviceName: string) {
    super();
  }

  public abstract processMutation(mutation: StateMutation<T>): Promise<void>;

  protected async emitStateChange(id: string, data: T): Promise<void> {
    this.emit('stateUpdated', { id, data, timestamp: Date.now() });
  }
}

export class LoomStateOrchestrator extends BaseDomainService<any> {
  private _isProcessing: boolean = false;

  constructor() {
    super('LoomStateOrchestrator');
  }

  public async processMutation(mutation: StateMutation<any>): Promise<void> {
    this._mutationQueue.push(mutation);
    this._mutationQueue.sort((a, b) => (a.priority === 'critical' ? -1 : 1));
    await this.flushQueue();
  }

  private async flushQueue(): Promise<void> {
    if (this._isProcessing) return;
    this._isProcessing = true;

    try {
      while (this._mutationQueue.length > 0) {
        const mutation = this._mutationQueue.shift();
        if (!mutation) continue;

        await this.executeAtomicTransition(mutation);
      }
    } finally {
      this._isProcessing = false;
    }
  }

  private async executeAtomicTransition(mutation: StateMutation<any>): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      try {
        const currentState = this._stateRegistry.get(mutation.id) || {};
        const nextState = { ...currentState, ...mutation.payload, _lastModified: mutation.timestamp };
        
        this._stateRegistry.set(mutation.id, nextState);
        this.emitStateChange(mutation.id, nextState);
        resolve();
      } catch (error) {
        reject(new Error(`Atomic Transition Failed: ${error}`));
      }
    });
  }
}

export class AsyncPipelineHandler {
  private static instance: AsyncPipelineHandler;
  private orchestrator: LoomStateOrchestrator = new LoomStateOrchestrator();

  private constructor() {}

  public static getInstance(): AsyncPipelineHandler {
    if (!this.instance) this.instance = new AsyncPipelineHandler();
    return this.instance;
  }

  public async executePipeline<T>(
    data: T, 
    context: PipelineContext, 
    transform: (d: T) => Promise<T>
  ): Promise<T> {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    
    try {
      const transformed = await transform(data);
      
      await this.orchestrator.processMutation({
        id: context.correlationId,
        payload: transformed,
        timestamp: startTime,
        priority: 'medium'
      });

      return transformed;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[Pipeline Error] Context: ${context.correlationId}`, err);
      throw err;
    }
  }
}

export const StateMutationFactory = {
  create: <T>(payload: T, priority: StateMutation<T>['priority'] = 'medium'): StateMutation<T> => ({
    id: uuidv4(),
    payload,
    timestamp: Date.now(),
    priority
  })
};

export default {
  LoomStateOrchestrator,
  AsyncPipelineHandler,
  StateMutationFactory
};

 * Segment 7: UI Component Presentation, Hook Handlers, Export Declarations, and File Termination.
 * This segment provides the final orchestration layer for the "Loom of Existence" application,
 * implementing the React-based presentation layer, state synchronization, and module exports.

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useLoomContext } from './LoomContext';
import { RealityEngine } from './RealityEngine';

/**
 * RealityPresentationLayer: The primary UI component that renders the 
 * "Loom of Existence" narrative interface.
 */
export const RealityPresentationLayer: React.FC = () => {
  const { state, dispatch } = useLoomContext();
  const [isVeilThin, setIsVeilThin] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Hook Handler: Orchestrates the transition between narrative states
  const handleVeilInteraction = useCallback((event: React.MouseEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setIsVeilThin((prev) => !prev);
    dispatch({ type: 'TOGGLE_PERCEPTION_DEPTH', payload: !isVeilThin });
  }, [dispatch, isVeilThin]);

  // Hook Handler: Synchronizes the engine state with the UI
  useEffect(() => {
    const engine = new RealityEngine();
    const subscription = engine.observe((update) => {
      dispatch({ type: 'SYNC_COSMIC_THREADS', payload: update });
    });

    return () => {
      subscription.unsubscribe();
      engine.dispose();
    };
  }, [dispatch]);

  // Memoized rendering of the narrative tapestry
  const renderedTapestry = useMemo(() => {
    return state.threads.map((thread, index) => (
      <div key={`thread-${index}`} className={`tapestry-node ${isVeilThin ? 'resonant' : 'static'}`}>
        <h3>{thread.title}</h3>
        <p>{thread.content}</p>
      </div>
    ));
  }, [state.threads, isVeilThin]);

  return (
    <section className="loom-container" aria-label="The Chronicle of Unseen Weaves">
      <header>
        <h1>The Loom of Existence</h1>
        <button onClick={handleVeilInteraction} aria-pressed={isVeilThin}>
          {isVeilThin ? 'The Veil is Thin' : 'Peer Beyond the Veil'}
        </button>
      </header>
      <main className="tapestry-grid">
        {renderedTapestry}
      </main>
      <footer className="epilogue">
        <p>The weave continues... always.</p>
      </footer>
    </section>
  );
};

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

// --- Asynchronous Pipeline Handlers ---

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

// --- State Mutation Algorithms ---

/**
 * Algorithms for calculating the "Combination" of threads.
 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.
 */
export const calculateEmergentProperty = (nodes: ThreadNode[]): number => {
  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;
  
  const sumOfWeights = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + (1 / n.frequency), 0);
  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

        resolve(true);
      }, 50);
    });
  }
}

/**

 * Orchestrates state mutation, event-driven data handling, and domain logic.

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export interface DomainEvent<T = any> {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  payload: T;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface StateMutation<S> {
  (state: S): S;
}

/**
 * Core Domain Service: Manages the lifecycle of state transitions
 * and ensures atomic updates across the asynchronous pipeline.
 */
export class LoomDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  private state: T;
  private readonly history: DomainEvent[] = [];

  constructor(initialState: T) {
    super();
    this.state = initialState;
  }

  public getState(): T {
    return Object.freeze({ ...this.state });
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Implements a middleware-like pattern for data validation and transformation.
   */
  public async mutate(mutation: StateMutation<T>, eventType: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const previousState = this.state;
      this.state = mutation(this.state);

      const event: DomainEvent = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        type: eventType,
        payload: this.state,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };

      this.history.push(event);
      this.emit('stateChanged', { event, previousState });
      this.emit(eventType, event);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', { type: 'MUTATION_FAILURE', error });
      throw new Error(`Domain Mutation Failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown'}`);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Data Handler: Orchestrates the ingestion and normalization of 
 * disparate data streams into the domain model.
 */
export class DataIngestionHandler {
  public static normalize(raw: any): Record<string, any> {
    return {
      ...raw,
      _processedAt: Date.now(),
      _correlationId: uuidv4(),
      _integrityHash: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(raw)).toString('base64').slice(0, 16)
    };
  }

  public static async processStream(stream: AsyncIterable<any>, service: LoomDomainService<any>): Promise<void> {
    for await (const chunk of stream) {
      const normalized = this.normalize(chunk);
      await service.mutate((s) => ({ ...s, ...normalized }), 'STREAM_INGESTION');
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Asynchronous Pipeline: Orchestrates complex business logic 
 * involving multiple domain services.
 */
export class OrchestrationPipeline {
  constructor(private readonly services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) {}

  public async executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, logic: (services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
    console.log(`[Pipeline] Initiating workflow: ${workflowId}`);
    try {
      await logic(this.services);
      console.log(`[Pipeline] Workflow ${workflowId} completed successfully.`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[Pipeline] Workflow ${workflowId} failed:`, err);
      throw err;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * State Mutation Algorithms: Pure functions for complex domain logic.
 */
export const DomainAlgorithms = {
  mergeState: <S>(base: S, patch: Partial<S>): S => ({ ...base, ...patch }),
  
  calculateResonance: (data: number[]): number => {
    return data.reduce((acc, val) => acc + Math.sin(val), 0) / data.length;
  },

  validateIntegrity: (state: any): boolean => {
    return state !== null && typeof state === 'object' && '_correlationId' in state;
  }
};

  LoomDomainService,
  DataIngestionHandler,
  OrchestrationPipeline,
  DomainAlgorithms
};

/**
 * Segment 4: Core Domain Services & State Mutation Algorithms
 * Orchestrates the asynchronous pipeline for reality-construct state transitions.
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export interface RealityState {
  id: string;
  layer: number;
  coherence: number;
  entropy: number;
  manifestation: Record<string, any>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface MutationEvent {
  type: 'STABILIZE' | 'RESONATE' | 'DISSOLVE';
  payload: Partial<RealityState>;
  priority: number;
}

export class LoomCoreService extends EventEmitter {
  private static instance: LoomCoreService;
  private stateRegistry: Map<string, RealityState> = new Map();
  private pipelineQueue: MutationEvent[] = [];

  private constructor() {
    super();
    this.initializePipeline();
  }

  public static getInstance(): LoomCoreService {
    if (!LoomCoreService.instance) {
      LoomCoreService.instance = new LoomCoreService();
    }
    return LoomCoreService.instance;
  }

  private initializePipeline(): void {
    setInterval(async () => {
      if (this.pipelineQueue.length > 0) {
        const event = this.pipelineQueue.shift();
        if (event) await this.processMutation(event);
      }
    }, 16); // 60Hz tick rate for reality simulation
  }

  public async commitState(state: Omit<RealityState, 'id' | 'timestamp'>): Promise<string> {
    const id = uuidv4();
    const newState: RealityState = {
      ...state,
      id,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    };
    this.stateRegistry.set(id, newState);
    this.emit('stateChanged', newState);
    return id;
  }

  public queueMutation(event: MutationEvent): void {
    this.pipelineQueue.push(event);
    this.pipelineQueue.sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority);
  }

  private async processMutation(event: MutationEvent): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const targetId = event.payload.id;
      if (!targetId || !this.stateRegistry.has(targetId)) {
        throw new Error(`Invalid state reference: ${targetId}`);
      }

      const currentState = this.stateRegistry.get(targetId)!;
      const mutatedState = this.applyAlgorithm(currentState, event);
      
      this.stateRegistry.set(targetId, mutatedState);
      this.emit('mutationApplied', mutatedState);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
    }
  }

  private applyAlgorithm(state: RealityState, event: MutationEvent): RealityState {
    // Core State Mutation Logic: Entropy-Coherence Balancing
    const delta = event.type === 'STABILIZE' ? 0.05 : -0.05;
    
    return {
      ...state,
      ...event.payload,
      coherence: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, state.coherence + delta)),
      entropy: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, state.entropy - delta)),
      timestamp: Date.now()
    };
  }

  public getSnapshot(id: string): RealityState | undefined {
    return this.stateRegistry.get(id);
  }
}

export class AsyncRealityPipeline {
  private core: LoomCoreService = LoomCoreService.getInstance();

  public async executeTransformation(id: string, intensity: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.core.queueMutation({
        type: 'RESONATE',
        payload: { id, coherence: intensity },
        priority: 10
      });
      
      this.core.once('mutationApplied', (state) => {
        if (state.id === id) resolve();
      });
      
      setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Pipeline Timeout')), 5000);
    });
  }
}

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';

export interface LoomState {
  id: string;
  layer: 'phenomenal' | 'noumenal' | 'transcendent';
  resonance: number;
  threads: Map<string, ThreadMetadata>;
  lastMutation: number;
}

export interface ThreadMetadata {
  origin: string;
  weight: number;
  entanglementId: string | null;
}

export class LoomEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;
  private readonly mutationQueue: Array<(s: LoomState) => LoomState> = [];

  constructor(initialLayer: LoomState['layer'] = 'phenomenal') {
    super();
    this.state = {
      id: uuidv4(),
      layer: initialLayer,
      resonance: 0.5,
      threads: new Map(),
      lastMutation: Date.now(),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Ensures atomic updates to the reality-scape.
   */
  public async mutateState(transform: (s: LoomState) => LoomState): Promise<LoomState> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      try {
        this.mutationQueue.push(transform);
        this.processQueue();
        resolve(this.state);
      } catch (error) {
        this.emit('error', error);
        reject(error);
      }
    });
  }

  private processQueue(): void {
    while (this.mutationQueue.length > 0) {
      const transform = this.mutationQueue.shift();
      if (transform) {
        this.state = transform({ ...this.state });
        this.state.lastMutation = Date.now();
        this.emit('stateChanged', this.state);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Core Domain Service: Thread Entanglement
   * Logic for linking disparate data points across the tapestry.
   */
  public entangleThreads(threadA: string, threadB: string): void {
    const entanglementId = uuidv4();
    this.mutateState((s) => {
      const tA = s.threads.get(threadA) || { origin: 'void', weight: 1, entanglementId: null };
      const tB = s.threads.get(threadB) || { origin: 'void', weight: 1, entanglementId: null };
      
      s.threads.set(threadA, { ...tA, entanglementId });
      s.threads.set(threadB, { ...tB, entanglementId });
      return s;
    });
  }

  /**
   * Business Logic: Resonance Calibration
   * Adjusts the systemic frequency based on observer input.
   */
  public calibrateResonance(delta: number): void {
    this.mutateState((s) => {
      s.resonance = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s.resonance + delta));
      return s;
    });
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, threads: new Map(this.state.threads) };
  }
}

      });

    });
  }
}

 * Core Domain Services: Asynchronous Pipeline & State Mutation Engine
 * Part 5: Orchestration of the Loom's Internal State Transitions

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export interface StateMutation<T> {
  id: string;
  payload: T;
  timestamp: number;
  priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
}

export interface PipelineContext {
  correlationId: string;
  depth: number;
  trace: string[];
}

export abstract class BaseDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  protected readonly _stateRegistry: Map<string, T> = new Map();
  protected readonly _mutationQueue: StateMutation<T>[] = [];

  constructor(protected readonly serviceName: string) {
    super();
  }

  public abstract processMutation(mutation: StateMutation<T>): Promise<void>;

  protected async emitStateChange(id: string, data: T): Promise<void> {
    this.emit('stateUpdated', { id, data, timestamp: Date.now() });
  }
}

export class LoomStateOrchestrator extends BaseDomainService<any> {
  private _isProcessing: boolean = false;

  constructor() {
    super('LoomStateOrchestrator');
  }

  public async processMutation(mutation: StateMutation<any>): Promise<void> {
    this._mutationQueue.push(mutation);
    this._mutationQueue.sort((a, b) => (a.priority === 'critical' ? -1 : 1));
    await this.flushQueue();
  }

  private async flushQueue(): Promise<void> {
    if (this._isProcessing) return;
    this._isProcessing = true;

    try {
      while (this._mutationQueue.length > 0) {
        const mutation = this._mutationQueue.shift();
        if (!mutation) continue;

        await this.executeAtomicTransition(mutation);
      }
    } finally {
      this._isProcessing = false;
    }
  }

  private async executeAtomicTransition(mutation: StateMutation<any>): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      try {
        const currentState = this._stateRegistry.get(mutation.id) || {};
        const nextState = { ...currentState, ...mutation.payload, _lastModified: mutation.timestamp };
        
        this._stateRegistry.set(mutation.id, nextState);
        this.emitStateChange(mutation.id, nextState);
        resolve();
      } catch (error) {
        reject(new Error(`Atomic Transition Failed: ${error}`));
      }
    });
  }
}

export class AsyncPipelineHandler {
  private static instance: AsyncPipelineHandler;
  private orchestrator: LoomStateOrchestrator = new LoomStateOrchestrator();

  private constructor() {}

  public static getInstance(): AsyncPipelineHandler {
    if (!this.instance) this.instance = new AsyncPipelineHandler();
    return this.instance;
  }

  public async executePipeline<T>(
    data: T, 
    context: PipelineContext, 
    transform: (d: T) => Promise<T>
  ): Promise<T> {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    
    try {
      const transformed = await transform(data);
      
      await this.orchestrator.processMutation({
        id: context.correlationId,
        payload: transformed,
        timestamp: startTime,
        priority: 'medium'
      });

      return transformed;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[Pipeline Error] Context: ${context.correlationId}`, err);
      throw err;
    }
  }
}

export const StateMutationFactory = {
  create: <T>(payload: T, priority: StateMutation<T>['priority'] = 'medium'): StateMutation<T> => ({
    id: uuidv4(),
    payload,
    timestamp: Date.now(),
    priority
  })
};

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';

/**
 * RealityPresentationLayer: The primary UI component that renders the 
 * "Loom of Existence" narrative interface.
 */
export const RealityPresentationLayer: React.FC = () => {
  const { state, dispatch } = useLoomContext();
  const [isVeilThin, setIsVeilThin] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Hook Handler: Orchestrates the transition between narrative states
  const handleVeilInteraction = useCallback((event: React.MouseEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setIsVeilThin((prev) => !prev);
    dispatch({ type: 'TOGGLE_PERCEPTION_DEPTH', payload: !isVeilThin });
  }, [dispatch, isVeilThin]);

  // Hook Handler: Synchronizes the engine state with the UI
  useEffect(() => {
    const engine = new RealityEngine();
    const subscription = engine.observe((update) => {
      dispatch({ type: 'SYNC_COSMIC_THREADS', payload: update });
    });

    return () => {
      subscription.unsubscribe();
      engine.dispose();
    };
  }, [dispatch]);

  // Memoized rendering of the narrative tapestry
  const renderedTapestry = useMemo(() => {
    return state.threads.map((thread, index) => (
      <div key={`thread-${index}`} className={`tapestry-node ${isVeilThin ? 'resonant' : 'static'}`}>
        <h3>{thread.title}</h3>
        <p>{thread.content}</p>
      </div>
    ));
  }, [state.threads, isVeilThin]);

  return (
    <section className="loom-container" aria-label="The Chronicle of Unseen Weaves">
      <header>
        <h1>The Loom of Existence</h1>
        <button onClick={handleVeilInteraction} aria-pressed={isVeilThin}>
          {isVeilThin ? 'The Veil is Thin' : 'Peer Beyond the Veil'}
        </button>
      </header>
      <main className="tapestry-grid">
        {renderedTapestry}
      </main>
      <footer className="epilogue">
        <p>The weave continues... always.</p>
      </footer>
    </section>
  );
};

/**
 * The LoomService manages the state mutation of the reality-weave.
 * It acts as the central registry for thread nodes and ensures 
 * transactional integrity during state transitions.
 */
export class LoomService extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;

  constructor(weaveId: string = uuidv4()) {
    super();
    this.state = {
      weaveId,
      nodes: new Map(),
      entropy: 0.0,
      isStable: true
    };
  }

  public async mutateState(nodeId: string, delta: Partial<ThreadNode>): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const node = this.state.nodes.get(nodeId);
      if (!node) throw new Error(`Node ${nodeId} not found in the current weave.`);

      const updatedNode = { ...node, ...delta, timestamp: Date.now() };
      this.state.nodes.set(nodeId, updatedNode);
      
      this.emit('stateChanged', { nodeId, updatedNode });
      await this.recalculateResonance();
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async recalculateResonance(): Promise<void> {
    // Asynchronous pipeline for calculating global weave stability
    const nodes = Array.from(this.state.nodes.values());
    const totalResonance = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + n.resonance, 0);
    this.state.entropy = 1.0 / (totalResonance + 0.001);
    this.state.isStable = this.state.entropy < 0.8;
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, nodes: new Map(this.state.nodes) };
  }
}

// --- Asynchronous Pipeline Handlers ---

/**
 * Pipeline for processing incoming energetic data streams.
 * Implements backpressure handling and asynchronous transformation.
 */
export class RealityPipeline {
  private queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private processing: boolean = false;

  public enqueue(task: () => Promise<void>): void {
    this.queue.push(task);
    this.process();
  }

  private async process(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.processing || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.processing = true;

    while (this.queue.length > 0) {
      const task = this.queue.shift();
      if (task) await task().catch(console.error);
    }

    this.processing = false;
  }
}

// --- State Mutation Algorithms ---

/**
 * Algorithms for calculating the "Combination" of threads.
 * Uses a weighted harmonic mean to determine the emergent property of the weave.
 */
export const calculateEmergentProperty = (nodes: ThreadNode[]): number => {
  if (nodes.length === 0) return 0;
  
  const sumOfWeights = nodes.reduce((acc, n) => acc + (1 / n.frequency), 0);
  return nodes.length / sumOfWeights;
};

        resolve(true);
      }, 50);
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Segment 3: Core Domain Services & Asynchronous Pipelines
 * Orchestrates state mutation, event-driven data handling, and domain logic.
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export interface DomainEvent<T = any> {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  payload: T;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface StateMutation<S> {
  (state: S): S;
}

/**
 * Core Domain Service: Manages the lifecycle of state transitions
 * and ensures atomic updates across the asynchronous pipeline.
 */
export class LoomDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  private state: T;
  private readonly history: DomainEvent[] = [];

  constructor(initialState: T) {
    super();
    this.state = initialState;
  }

  public getState(): T {
    return Object.freeze({ ...this.state });
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Implements a middleware-like pattern for data validation and transformation.
   */
  public async mutate(mutation: StateMutation<T>, eventType: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const previousState = this.state;
      this.state = mutation(this.state);

      const event: DomainEvent = {
        id: uuidv4(),
        type: eventType,
        payload: this.state,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
      };

      this.history.push(event);
      this.emit('stateChanged', { event, previousState });
      this.emit(eventType, event);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', { type: 'MUTATION_FAILURE', error });
      throw new Error(`Domain Mutation Failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown'}`);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Data Handler: Orchestrates the ingestion and normalization of 
 * disparate data streams into the domain model.
 */
export class DataIngestionHandler {
  public static normalize(raw: any): Record<string, any> {
    return {
      ...raw,
      _processedAt: Date.now(),
      _correlationId: uuidv4(),
      _integrityHash: Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(raw)).toString('base64').slice(0, 16)
    };
  }

  public static async processStream(stream: AsyncIterable<any>, service: LoomDomainService<any>): Promise<void> {
    for await (const chunk of stream) {
      const normalized = this.normalize(chunk);
      await service.mutate((s) => ({ ...s, ...normalized }), 'STREAM_INGESTION');
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Asynchronous Pipeline: Orchestrates complex business logic 
 * involving multiple domain services.
 */
export class OrchestrationPipeline {
  constructor(private readonly services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) {}

  public async executeWorkflow(workflowId: string, logic: (services: Map<string, LoomDomainService<any>>) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
    console.log(`[Pipeline] Initiating workflow: ${workflowId}`);
    try {
      await logic(this.services);
      console.log(`[Pipeline] Workflow ${workflowId} completed successfully.`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[Pipeline] Workflow ${workflowId} failed:`, err);
      throw err;
    }
  }
}

/**
 * State Mutation Algorithms: Pure functions for complex domain logic.
 */
export const DomainAlgorithms = {
  mergeState: <S>(base: S, patch: Partial<S>): S => ({ ...base, ...patch }),
  
  calculateResonance: (data: number[]): number => {
    return data.reduce((acc, val) => acc + Math.sin(val), 0) / data.length;
  },

  validateIntegrity: (state: any): boolean => {
    return state !== null && typeof state === 'object' && '_correlationId' in state;
  }
};

export default {
  LoomDomainService,
  DataIngestionHandler,
  OrchestrationPipeline,
  DomainAlgorithms
};

/**
 * Segment 4: Core Domain Services & State Mutation Algorithms
 * Orchestrates the asynchronous pipeline for reality-construct state transitions.
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export interface RealityState {
  id: string;
  layer: number;
  coherence: number;
  entropy: number;
  manifestation: Record<string, any>;
  timestamp: number;
}

export interface MutationEvent {
  type: 'STABILIZE' | 'RESONATE' | 'DISSOLVE';
  payload: Partial<RealityState>;
  priority: number;
}

export class LoomCoreService extends EventEmitter {
  private static instance: LoomCoreService;
  private stateRegistry: Map<string, RealityState> = new Map();
  private pipelineQueue: MutationEvent[] = [];

  private constructor() {
    super();
    this.initializePipeline();
  }

  public static getInstance(): LoomCoreService {
    if (!LoomCoreService.instance) {
      LoomCoreService.instance = new LoomCoreService();
    }
    return LoomCoreService.instance;
  }

  private initializePipeline(): void {
    setInterval(async () => {
      if (this.pipelineQueue.length > 0) {
        const event = this.pipelineQueue.shift();
        if (event) await this.processMutation(event);
      }
    }, 16); // 60Hz tick rate for reality simulation
  }

  public async commitState(state: Omit<RealityState, 'id' | 'timestamp'>): Promise<string> {
    const id = uuidv4();
    const newState: RealityState = {
      ...state,
      id,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    };
    this.stateRegistry.set(id, newState);
    this.emit('stateChanged', newState);
    return id;
  }

  public queueMutation(event: MutationEvent): void {
    this.pipelineQueue.push(event);
    this.pipelineQueue.sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority);
  }

  private async processMutation(event: MutationEvent): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const targetId = event.payload.id;
      if (!targetId || !this.stateRegistry.has(targetId)) {
        throw new Error(`Invalid state reference: ${targetId}`);
      }

      const currentState = this.stateRegistry.get(targetId)!;
      const mutatedState = this.applyAlgorithm(currentState, event);
      
      this.stateRegistry.set(targetId, mutatedState);
      this.emit('mutationApplied', mutatedState);
    } catch (error) {
      this.emit('error', error);
    }
  }

  private applyAlgorithm(state: RealityState, event: MutationEvent): RealityState {
    // Core State Mutation Logic: Entropy-Coherence Balancing
    const delta = event.type === 'STABILIZE' ? 0.05 : -0.05;
    
    return {
      ...state,
      ...event.payload,
      coherence: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, state.coherence + delta)),
      entropy: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, state.entropy - delta)),
      timestamp: Date.now()
    };
  }

  public getSnapshot(id: string): RealityState | undefined {
    return this.stateRegistry.get(id);
  }
}

export class AsyncRealityPipeline {
  private core: LoomCoreService = LoomCoreService.getInstance();

  public async executeTransformation(id: string, intensity: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.core.queueMutation({
        type: 'RESONATE',
        payload: { id, coherence: intensity },
        priority: 10
      });
      
      this.core.once('mutationApplied', (state) => {
        if (state.id === id) resolve();
      });
      
      setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Pipeline Timeout')), 5000);
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Segment 5: Core Domain Services & State Mutation Algorithms
 * Orchestrates the "Loom" state transitions and asynchronous event pipelines.
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export interface LoomState {
  id: string;
  layer: 'phenomenal' | 'noumenal' | 'transcendent';
  resonance: number;
  threads: Map<string, ThreadMetadata>;
  lastMutation: number;
}

export interface ThreadMetadata {
  origin: string;
  weight: number;
  entanglementId: string | null;
}

export class LoomEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private state: LoomState;
  private readonly mutationQueue: Array<(s: LoomState) => LoomState> = [];

  constructor(initialLayer: LoomState['layer'] = 'phenomenal') {
    super();
    this.state = {
      id: uuidv4(),
      layer: initialLayer,
      resonance: 0.5,
      threads: new Map(),
      lastMutation: Date.now(),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Asynchronous pipeline for state mutation.
   * Ensures atomic updates to the reality-scape.
   */
  public async mutateState(transform: (s: LoomState) => LoomState): Promise<LoomState> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      try {
        this.mutationQueue.push(transform);
        this.processQueue();
        resolve(this.state);
      } catch (error) {
        this.emit('error', error);
        reject(error);
      }
    });
  }

  private processQueue(): void {
    while (this.mutationQueue.length > 0) {
      const transform = this.mutationQueue.shift();
      if (transform) {
        this.state = transform({ ...this.state });
        this.state.lastMutation = Date.now();
        this.emit('stateChanged', this.state);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Core Domain Service: Thread Entanglement
   * Logic for linking disparate data points across the tapestry.
   */
  public entangleThreads(threadA: string, threadB: string): void {
    const entanglementId = uuidv4();
    this.mutateState((s) => {
      const tA = s.threads.get(threadA) || { origin: 'void', weight: 1, entanglementId: null };
      const tB = s.threads.get(threadB) || { origin: 'void', weight: 1, entanglementId: null };
      
      s.threads.set(threadA, { ...tA, entanglementId });
      s.threads.set(threadB, { ...tB, entanglementId });
      return s;
    });
  }

  /**
   * Business Logic: Resonance Calibration
   * Adjusts the systemic frequency based on observer input.
   */
  public calibrateResonance(delta: number): void {
    this.mutateState((s) => {
      s.resonance = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s.resonance + delta));
      return s;
    });
  }

  public getSnapshot(): LoomState {
    return { ...this.state, threads: new Map(this.state.threads) };
  }
}

/**
 * Data Handler: Reality Stream Processor
 * Manages the flow of noumenal data into phenomenal structures.
 */
export class RealityStreamProcessor {
  private engine: LoomEngine;

  constructor(engine: LoomEngine) {
    this.engine = engine;
  }

  public async ingest(data: Record<string, any>): Promise<void> {
    await this.engine.mutateState((s) => {
      const threadId = uuidv4();
      s.threads.set(threadId, {
        origin: 'external_input',
        weight: data.intensity || 1,
        entanglementId: null
      });
      return s;
    });
  }
}

export const createLoomService = () => {
  const engine = new LoomEngine();
  const processor = new RealityStreamProcessor(engine);
  return { engine, processor };
};

/**
 * Core Domain Services: Asynchronous Pipeline & State Mutation Engine
 * Part 5: Orchestration of the Loom's Internal State Transitions
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

export interface StateMutation<T> {
  id: string;
  payload: T;
  timestamp: number;
  priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
}

export interface PipelineContext {
  correlationId: string;
  depth: number;
  trace: string[];
}

export abstract class BaseDomainService<T> extends EventEmitter {
  protected readonly _stateRegistry: Map<string, T> = new Map();
  protected readonly _mutationQueue: StateMutation<T>[] = [];

  constructor(protected readonly serviceName: string) {
    super();
  }

  public abstract processMutation(mutation: StateMutation<T>): Promise<void>;

  protected async emitStateChange(id: string, data: T): Promise<void> {
    this.emit('stateUpdated', { id, data, timestamp: Date.now() });
  }
}

export class LoomStateOrchestrator extends BaseDomainService<any> {
  private _isProcessing: boolean = false;

  constructor() {
    super('LoomStateOrchestrator');
  }

  public async processMutation(mutation: StateMutation<any>): Promise<void> {
    this._mutationQueue.push(mutation);
    this._mutationQueue.sort((a, b) => (a.priority === 'critical' ? -1 : 1));
    await this.flushQueue();
  }

  private async flushQueue(): Promise<void> {
    if (this._isProcessing) return;
    this._isProcessing = true;

    try {
      while (this._mutationQueue.length > 0) {
        const mutation = this._mutationQueue.shift();
        if (!mutation) continue;

        await this.executeAtomicTransition(mutation);
      }
    } finally {
      this._isProcessing = false;
    }
  }

  private async executeAtomicTransition(mutation: StateMutation<any>): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      try {
        const currentState = this._stateRegistry.get(mutation.id) || {};
        const nextState = { ...currentState, ...mutation.payload, _lastModified: mutation.timestamp };
        
        this._stateRegistry.set(mutation.id, nextState);
        this.emitStateChange(mutation.id, nextState);
        resolve();
      } catch (error) {
        reject(new Error(`Atomic Transition Failed: ${error}`));
      }
    });
  }
}

export class AsyncPipelineHandler {
  private static instance: AsyncPipelineHandler;
  private orchestrator: LoomStateOrchestrator = new LoomStateOrchestrator();

  private constructor() {}

  public static getInstance(): AsyncPipelineHandler {
    if (!this.instance) this.instance = new AsyncPipelineHandler();
    return this.instance;
  }

  public async executePipeline<T>(
    data: T, 
    context: PipelineContext, 
    transform: (d: T) => Promise<T>
  ): Promise<T> {
    const startTime = Date.now();
    
    try {
      const transformed = await transform(data);
      
      await this.orchestrator.processMutation({
        id: context.correlationId,
        payload: transformed,
        timestamp: startTime,
        priority: 'medium'
      });

      return transformed;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[Pipeline Error] Context: ${context.correlationId}`, err);
      throw err;
    }
  }
}

export const StateMutationFactory = {
  create: <T>(payload: T, priority: StateMutation<T>['priority'] = 'medium'): StateMutation<T> => ({
    id: uuidv4(),
    payload,
    timestamp: Date.now(),
    priority
  })
};

  LoomStateOrchestrator,
  AsyncPipelineHandler,
  StateMutationFactory
};

        {renderedTapestry}
      </main>
      <footer className="epilogue">
        <p>The weave continues... always.</p>
      </footer>
    </section>
  );
};
